{{Top|leg}}
'''Cuticle implants''' were platinum fingernails that were both painful and costly to be inserted. People who wore them often cut themselves by accident. [[General/Legends|General]] [[Melvar]], who was affiliated with the [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]], wore them and had thin white scars on his face as a result of accidentally scratching himself with them.
